annotations.title: Price of one kWh of electricity and gas

description: An indicative calculation, not yet checked by an independent expert (verified: false); show estimate_note with the result. Price of one kWh with VAT for households of a country (Czechia for now), per distributor area, computed only from the energy regulator's tables and the suppliers' official price lists we read: regulated_kwh (variable regulated part: distribution of the rate, system services, renewables support, tax; the same with every supplier), supplier_kwh (commodity price: min, median, max over the priced offers), marginal_kwh (regulated + supplier: the cost of one more kWh, what an appliance costs to run) and all_in_kwh (the yearly total for `mwh` with every fixed fee spread over its kWh). Electricity for one rate (default D02d) and 2.5 MWh a year by default; gas for 9 MWh a year by default. Spot and formula prices are never counted. Use estimate_appliance_energy for an appliance's yearly cost.
